inspection_side_effect.explanation: Both Python property/graph passes ended with only the pre-existing dirty Cook mesh. Later get_material_info queries covered 15 MW functions; final readback found the same 15 packages dirty. Tool-related dirtying is the leading inference; exact engine-side changes are unproved. No explicit asset setter, save, cook/bake, map switch, owner write or editor close was issued. Editor calls stopped on discovery; buffers untouched.

functions.purpose: Lerps each normal from flat (0,0,1) with intensity, adds XY and multiplies Z. Normalize node exists but is not on the output connection.
functions.call_as_is: Yes with explicit intensities and compatible tangent-space normals. Normalize in the new enabled branch as appropriate.

functions.purpose: Adds normal XY and multiplies Z. No texture fetches.
functions.call_as_is: Yes for compatible tangent-space normals. Combine is not a distance fade.

functions.purpose: Engine CameraDepthFade, For Vertex Shader=true. Parameters MW_DistanceBlendFadeLength=4096 and MW_DistanceBlendFadeOffset=512. This is camera distance, not scene intersection DepthFade.
functions.call_as_is: Yes; shared MW parameter names will appear on the caller. Wrap/remap for independent per-role control.

functions.purpose: Selects LandscapeLayerCoords or world XY, with MW_LandscapeWorldUVSize=384; MW_UseWorldPositionUVs=true. Also returns raw world XY. Planar, not triplanar.
functions.call_as_is: Yes on our Landscape. Contains LandscapeLayerCoords but no painted-layer names. Prefer feeding retained world XY UVs directly to DefaultLayer to retain existing scale control.

functions.purpose: Sequential Rock/Stones/Grass/Dirt color and normal blends with optional Snow normals, supplied masks and distance alpha. Uses MW_UseSnow. Not LandscapeLayerBlend and not texture-height blending.
functions.call_as_is: Technically callable, but not a direct replacement for our named-weight blends. Its slots/order encode MW biomes; prefer reusable per-role sampling functions.

functions.purpose: pow((MW_UseInvertedRoughness ? 1-input : input) * MW_RoughnessMultiplier, MW_RoughnessPower), defaults true/1/0.5. No texture unpacking. The master supplies color-derived modulation times weighted per-role scalars.
functions.call_as_is: Yes, but default behavior is not identity. Gate and clamp separately. Do not describe color-derived roughness as a measured roughness map.

functions.purpose: Blends BaseColor toward SnowBaseColor with SnowPixelMask, gated by MW_UseSnow.

Samples color and normal at near/far UVs. Color alpha = DepthFadeMask * 0.75. Static options apply color correction, normal XY intensity and UV multipliers. Four Shared:Wrap sample nodes. No bombing, stochastic rotation, triplanar or height blend.
functions.call_as_is: Yes with explicit inputs. Set WaterRefractionUV=(0,0), white ColorCorrection, NormalIntensity=1 and deliberate static booleans. ColorCorrection preview is black. NormalNear/NormalFar are separate outputs, not a final distance-normal blend.

functions.purpose: Engine SlopeMask calls combine pixel-normal and base-slope responses with world-elevation gating; separate color/normal mask outputs.
functions.call_as_is: Conditional: do not connect the PixelNormalWS-dependent SlopeMask output back into Normal. SlopeNormalMask is the separate route. Do not replace geographic paint weights with its absolute elevation thresholds.

functions.purpose: World elevation, input noise and slope, with pixel/vertex normals, produce separate snow masks.
functions.call_as_is: Callable but unnecessary for Gaza dry ground. Pixel-normal result must not drive a normal feedback loop.

functions.purpose: Slope/elevation/noise mask, snow exclusion and MW_UseWater switch.
functions.call_as_is: Callable; omit for dry Gaza. Not an object-contact detector.

functions.purpose: Two panned water-normal samples, normal combine, mask-driven color/specular/roughness/metallic and WaterRefractionUV; MW_UseWater switch.
functions.call_as_is: Callable with inputs; omit for dry ground. Wetness/puddles are not RVT or road/building contact.

functions.purpose: World position relative to engine ObjectPivotPoint makes an object-height mask for cover/foliage.
functions.call_as_is: Technically callable, but Landscape pivot does not identify building footprints. Not a contact solution.

functions.purpose: Optional subsurface texture/base-color path with color and intensity controls for foliage.
functions.call_as_is: Callable but not useful for opaque DefaultLit ground without a shading change outside this proposal.

functions.purpose: Foliage opacity, camera-distance fade and DitherTemporalAA controls.
functions.call_as_is: Not appropriate for the retained opaque ground contact problem; do not import its opacity/dither behavior.

retained_contract.Iran: Profile uses base MI directly; Iran world not loaded.

mapping_proposal.wiring: Keep the existing named-layer blends and wider bank palette. Add new GeoCity_MW texture-object parameters inside a default-off switch: SandA for Ground, SandC for soil partner/BuildingPad, conditional Stones for stony RoadBed/Steep. After LandscapeLayerBlend_6, apply coherent world-XY macro color with default amount 0.
mapping_proposal.limit: MW macro color is inline mask RGB * blended color * 1.5, not a named macro function. A proposed MF_GeoCity_MW_MacroColor would be new project logic. Use white-to-variation interpolation so amount 0 is identity.

mapping_proposal.wiring: Use retained world XY near/far UVs and camera-distance fade in DefaultLayer. Add a project far-color target with amount 0 by default. Separately gate a normal fade toward (0,0,1) after LandscapeLayerBlend_7.
mapping_proposal.limit: MW blends the same texture at two scales with alpha=0.75*DepthFadeMask; this does not change its far mip mean reliably. A controlled far color is added project logic, not a discovered MW feature. Lighting/exposure was not diagnosed.

mapping_proposal.wiring: Use distance sampling and coherent macro variation across the four roles. Preserve ratified GeoCity_GroundStochastic_20261005 and review its active routes before replacing sampling inputs. Avoid stacking a second expensive sampler system.
mapping_proposal.limit: No MW UV bombing, stochastic rotation or triplanar function found. Stronger anti-tiling requires retained/custom logic; UV rotation must rotate normal XY consistently.

mapping_proposal.wiring: Share macro variation across seams. Keep geographic weights/names and Grass input untouched. Future appearance-only noise modulation may refine existing fractional transition weights, with renormalization.
mapping_proposal.limit: MF_MWAM_LayerBlend is not height blending. No MW height map found. A pointwise remap cannot widen a binary mask into a spatial feather. Wider masks remain manager-owned producer work.

mapping_proposal.wiring: Do not use these functions as contact detectors. Later provide a real road/pad edge-distance/contact mask, then separately gate a subtle darkening/roughness band without altering Grass exclusions.
mapping_proposal.limit: CameraDepthFade is camera distance, PivotMask is object pivot and Water is wetness. Pack has no RVT/contact system or geometry grounding repair. These cannot close physical gaps; contact geometry/decal/RVT work is not delivered.
